He holds a dark grey smartphone and speaks directly to the camera with an animated expression. (2) The scene shifts to a close-up of a desk where the man's hands are visible using a stylus on the smartphone screen. A grey mechanical keyboard is positioned next to the phone. (3) The man is shown back at the whiteboard, demonstrating the phone's AI features. He gestures towards the board and the device. (4) A screen recording of the smartphone interface appears, showing a document being summarized by an AI tool with text highlighting and scrolling. (5) Another screen recording shows the Gemini Live interface performing a search query. (6) A close-up shot shows a finger on the phone screen using a generative AI tool to circle and remove a person from the background of a photograph. (7) The man returns to the eye-level medium shot at the whiteboard, holding the phone and speaking confidently to conclude the video.
